rooms.1: A dismal swamp at dawn: a huge ancient cypress tree draped in Spanish moss rising from still, murky water in the centre, its broad canopy dark green, gnarled roots and knees poking from mud flats tinged pink with algae, mist hanging low over the water, a pale grey sky.
rooms.2: View from high in a tall cypress tree: a thick moss-hung branch reaching across the foreground on the left, a dew-beaded spider web stretched between twigs catching the light, and far below a misty swamp of water and cypress tops with a distant green hill under a soft pale sky.
rooms.3: Inside a damp hollow tree stump: curving walls of rotting reddish-brown wood with moss and fungus, a ragged opening high above letting in a shaft of daylight and a patch of blue sky, a dark hole in the soft leaf-litter floor leading down.
rooms.4: A root chamber under a tree stump: a low earthen cave whose ceiling and walls are a writhing tangle of thick roots, some reddish and some bluish-grey, a dark round tunnel opening in the far wall, a smooth packed-earth floor, dim warm light.
rooms.5: A semi-dark hole by a root chamber: a small rocky alcove in darkness lit from the left. A tall, narrow closed wooden door is set into the reddish rock a little LEFT of centre (its left edge about 30% across the picture, its right edge about 42%), standing on the floor; the rest of the rock wall is bare.
rooms.6: A long, down-sloping hall of red sandstone: jagged rock walls closing in on both sides, the floor sloping steeply down to a small dark opening far ahead, a faint warm light from behind, dust in the air.
rooms.7: A large cavern: a vast cave of red and ochre rock with dark overhanging formations and stalactites, several shadowed openings in the walls, a broad smooth floor of pinkish stone, lit by a soft glow from above.
rooms.8: A large eight-sided chamber: walls of polished green marble in eight panels meeting at gilded corners, a floor of deep blue tiles, soft light from above pooling in the centre, quiet and strange, the scent of honey in the air.
rooms.9: A royal anteroom: a stately hall lined with tall fluted white marble columns, a polished deep blue floor reflecting them, and at the far end a narrow doorway framed in gold with a red royal emblem above it, cool light.
rooms.10: The shore of a lake: calm blue water stretching to a wooded far shore, a grassy bank in the foreground with a blank weathered wooden sign on two posts at the water's edge, white clouds drifting in a bright summer sky.
rooms.11: A deep forest: tall gnarled reddish-brown trunks under a thick canopy of green leaves, shafts of sunlight slanting through, ferns and tufts of grass on the forest floor, a glimpse of blue sky between the branches.
rooms.12: A maze of pits: a vast, eerie plain of interlocking stone walls and deep square pits carved in rose-coloured and pale turquoise stone, stretching in zig-zags to a hazy horizon under a violet dusk sky, soft light raking across the carved edges, mysterious and puzzling.
rooms.13: A maze of pits: a vast, eerie plain of interlocking stone walls and deep square pits carved in rose-coloured and pale turquoise stone, stretching in zig-zags to a hazy horizon under a violet dusk sky, soft light raking across the carved edges, mysterious and puzzling.

rooms.18: The bottom of a very deep chasm: towering walls of red and blue-grey rock rising out of sight, two small ledges far above on either side, one with a bricked-up window, a glowing stream of molten orange lava winding across the dark floor, heat haze and smoke.
rooms.19: A narrow rock ledge by a deep chasm, in darkness: a small jutting outcrop of stone lit by a single soft beam from above, an endless black void all around, the faint red glow of lava far below.
rooms.20: A royal chamber: walls hung with green striped drapery, a red carpeted floor, a canopy bed at the far left and a small throne-like chair at the right. High on the far wall, EXACTLY in the horizontal centre of the picture, a small window that has been bricked up with pale stones.
rooms.21: A narrow ledge by a throne-room, in darkness: a wide flat rock ledge running across the whole LOWER part of the picture, its top surface at about two thirds of the way down, lit by a beam from above; an archway into a throne room at the far right; black void above.
rooms.22: A throne room: a golden throne with a red velvet cushion on a raised dais of blue stone steps, flanked by two tall pillars striped green and white topped with glowing globes, walls of rich red damask, warm candlelight.
rooms.23: A sunny meadow: a wide meadow of lush green grass and wildflowers rolling to distant pink-tinged mountains, white clouds and a bright sun, a weathered blank wooden signpost on the left, open grass in the centre and right.
rooms.24: Hell: a grinning horned devil with a pointed tail and a pitchfork, red skin glistening, standing amid roaring flames and glowing embers in a cavern of black rock, terrifying and darkly comic.
rooms.25: A hidden grove: a sunlit clearing ringed by old trees with gnarled reddish trunks and dense green leaves, a small clear stream on the right, a blank white wooden sign on a post in the foreground, dappled light.
rooms.26: A quicksand bog: a sinister pool of grey-brown sucking quicksand in a clearing, dark trees around the edge, tall reeds and cattails with seed heads leaning in from both sides, still and humid.
rooms.27: Inside the memory chip of a computer: standing in a glowing canyon of circuitry, traces of gold and copper running like roads between towering black chips and capacitors, red and blue lights pulsing, a cool electric haze.
rooms.28: The top of an oak tree: thick leafy branches framing the view on the left and below, and far off to the east a green meadow and beyond it a sparkling blue lake under a bright sky with soft clouds.
rooms.29: The edge of a bottomless hole: a sunny green field with birds in the sky, a huge dark jagged hole torn in the ground in the centre with crumbling edges, and a large blank weathered wooden billboard on two posts beside it.
rooms.30: A ledge just below the rim of a bottomless hole: looking up past red earth and dangling roots at the green grass and blue sky at the rim above, the dark depth falling away below into blackness.
rooms.31: A long tunnel of dark blue-grey rock curving away ahead into darkness, damp walls glistening, a faint golden glow far off where a buzzing seems to come from.
rooms.32: An endless corridor: a long straight corridor with smooth walls of pale green stone stretching away forever in perfect perspective, a polished deep blue floor, a single opening in the left wall, soft even light, dreamlike and uncanny.
rooms.33: Limbo: a large misty room with rose-pink walls and a green stone floor, swirls of glowing mist drifting across it, dark doorways on every side with strange unreadable glowing runes carved above them, otherworldly light.

items.17: A tall, narrow arched wooden door swung wide open inside a rough reddish-brown rock doorway, with a warmly lit stone hallway beyond. Tall and narrow in shape (about two and a half times as tall as wide); the reddish rock frame forms the edges of the object.
items.25: A very thin, starving black bear standing on all fours, ribs showing, looking hungry and menacing.
items.27: A large green dragon curled up asleep on the ground, wings folded, smoke curling from its nostrils.
items.29: A thick, richly patterned Persian rug, rolled out flat, seen from slightly above, deep red with gold and blue designs.
items.35: A small window that was bricked up with pale stones, now with a ragged hole knocked through its middle showing darkness beyond, in a stone frame.
items.39: A black bear lying fast asleep on its side, eyes closed, peaceful.
items.43: A black bear sitting back unsteadily, looking dizzy and woozy, eyes half closed, swaying.
